verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented way for users to define event-triggered automation rules in Obsidian. The URI protocol lets external callers trigger actions on demand rather than on events. Automatic link updating on rename is a fixed built-in behavior, not a user-defined rule. The plugin API is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
